title: Amount of a Rate-Year Correction on a Resident Coinsurance Charge — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage.** The rate-year correction on a resident coinsurance charge applies to the resident's original coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block, that is, among the coverage's booked-days entries in the band of benefit days 21 through 100 the one whose last service date is the latest, and it takes back what that charge billed above the daily rate of the year in which the corrected block's days were furnished.

**Record test.** The rate-year correction is worked out only for a corrected block that passes this record test: its service month carries one booked-days entry in the band of benefit days 21 through 100; at most one such entry of the coverage has the last benefit day just before the corrected block's first benefit day; the bed-hold records book at most one leave for its service month and take back none of that leave's held days; its booked-days entry carries at most one day reversal for each reason and none for a booking error; no hospital-day or leave-of-absence reversal on it covers a held night of that leave, and each such reversal counts every day of its span; an uncertified-day reversal on it counts every day of its span except the held nights and the hospital-day and leave-of-absence days inside the span; and, when the supplemental effective date falls after the corrected block's first service date, the block before it either has a resident charge billing exactly 100, 50 or 25 percent of that charge's own days times its own daily rate, to within half a percentage point, or carries a secondary charge and no resident charge; and, when the resident's charge for the corrected block stands, its day count equals the corrected block's booked days less the days of every day reversal posted against its booked-days entry on or before the date that charge was posted; and the corrected block's last service date falls in 2024 or later. The block before the corrected block is the coverage's booked-days entry in the band of benefit days 21 through 100 whose last benefit day is the day before the corrected block's first benefit day; its resident charge is the resident coinsurance charge posted for it that is not a rebill of a denied secondary share.

For a block that passes its record test, the resident coinsurance charge, the card payment, the rate-year correction, the reduction for reversed covered days and the bank draft each count the days before the supplemental effective date as their own policies state, and only for such a block; for every other block, the tier that sets the split is the one in effect on the days of service: a Medigap policy changes the split from the carrier's policy effective date and QMB protection from the first day of the month after the state's QMB determination, so days before the supplemental effective date keep the earlier split, and none of these five figures is priced for it.

**Amount of the correction.**

- The rate-year correction prices each day it counts at the daily coinsurance rate of 204.00 as the year-of-service rate, and days before the supplemental effective date take the earlier share of 100 percent.
- The supplemental effective date the rate-year correction reads is the one recorded on the coverage; a coverage that records none has the tier on file in effect on every day of the corrected block.
- The rate-year correction counts the days the resident's charge prices and works the figure twice, once at the daily rate that charge records and once at the year-of-service rate; the correction is the first rounded figure less the second, never less than nothing and never more than the charge's open balance, which is its amount less the payments and adjustments posted against it plus any returned payments.
- The days the rate-year correction counts before the supplemental effective date are first its calendar days of the corrected block before that date: when the date falls after the corrected block's first service date and on or before its last, the days from the first service date up to the day before the date; when it falls after the last service date, every calendar day of the corrected block; otherwise none.
- Each kind of day named below that is not a covered day is taken off those days, never leaving fewer than none nor more than the days the rate-year correction counts.
- A day reversed as an uncertified day is not a covered day: when the corrected block's booked-days entry carries an uncertified-day reversal posted on or before the date the charge was posted, the days of its span before the supplemental effective date come off the days the rate-year correction counts before that date, all of the span when its last day falls before the date, the days from its first day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first day and on or before its last, and none otherwise, in each case less the held nights and the hospital-day and leave-of-absence days inside that part of the span, which the reversal did not reverse; without such a reversal, none come off.
- Days the rate-year correction counts before the supplemental effective date take the earlier share; every other day it counts takes the resident share of the tier on file. The resident share of the tier on file is that tier's resident share percent in the cost-sharing split schedule. When the tier on file prohibits balance billing, as the QMB Medicaid Crossover tier does, the rate-year correction bills the resident nothing for any day on or after the tier's supplemental effective date, those days taking the tier's resident share of nothing, while days before that date keep the earlier split, QMB protection not reaching back before it.
- The rate-year correction adds, over the days it counts, the daily rate times the share each day takes, divides the sum by 100 and rounds it half up to the cent once.

### Hypothetical worked examples

| | Example 1 | Example 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Tier and resident share | Medigap Plan A or B, 100 percent | Medigap Plan A or B, 100 percent |
| Supplemental effective date | None recorded | None recorded |
| Days the resident's charge prices | 11 | 11 |
| Daily rate the charge records | 217.00 | 204.00 |
| First figure (recorded rate), rounded once | 2387.00 | 2244.00 |
| Second figure (year-of-service rate 204.00), rounded once | 2244.00 | 2244.00 |
| Difference | 143.00 | 0.00 |
| Open balance of the charge | 2387.00 | 2244.00 |
| Rate-year correction | **143.00** | **0.00** (never less than nothing) |
